clues.title: Two invoices, one delivery
clues.summary: In the accounts payable sample, Corvane Materials billed the same pallet-liner delivery twice under different invoice numbers. Both were paid. Both approvals came from the COO's office, not Procurement.

clues.title: A late meeting
clues.summary: Callum saw Celeste Marlow leaving the Harrowgate site office at 9 p.m. with Corvane's managing director. Nobody from Procurement was there.

clues.title: The override log
clues.summary: Seven supplier approvals in the last year bypassed the Procurement sign-off rule using the 'operational emergency' override. Six were Corvane. All six were authorised by one login: the COO's executive assistant account.

clues.title: Standby capacity nobody used
clues.summary: Valtren pays Tessaline Haulage Services 22,000 a month for standby refrigerated capacity. The fleet system shows Tessaline vehicles were called out twice in two years.

clues.title: Who owns Tessaline
clues.summary: Company registry: Tessaline Haulage Services has one director, D. Marlow, and its registered address is a flat above a dry cleaner's. Tessaline owns no vehicles.

clues.title: The rebate schedule
clues.summary: A side letter attached to the Corvane contract pays a 'logistics coordination rebate' of 15% of Corvane's invoices to Tessaline. Valtren's money goes to Corvane, and part of it comes back to Tessaline.

clues.title: The discount that costs money
clues.summary: Corvane's exclusive offer is 12% cheaper on paper. With the 15% rebate to Tessaline priced back in through Corvane's raised list prices, Valtren would pay about 4% more, locked in for three years.

clues.title: Closed without investigation
clues.summary: Three speak-up reports about Corvane pricing in two years. Each was closed as 'commercial matter, no action' by the COO's office within a week, against the policy that sends them to Internal Audit.

clues.title: Tomasz's account
clues.summary: Tomasz Brennan says he raised Corvane's pricing with the COO two years ago and was told his job depended on 'supporting the operational strategy'. He kept copies of everything.

clues.title: The offer, in writing
clues.summary: Celeste's message to you: drop the supplier review, and she will sponsor you for Director 'this cycle, not next'. She wrote it down.
